answer: A bond of 39% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in kernel, and pearl reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 197 aliases, and each one needs its own funded jade account. That bill is paid per identity, so 220 aliases cost 190 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
